body:
10am // After waking up alone for the first time in a long time, I wrote off the day and took 600mg of Pregabalin after my morning smoke wasnt hitting the spot. I spent the next hour or so crying, waiting for it to kick in, getting gradually more stoned. The hash isnt great for this kind of thing, I would prefer a stronger herb, it just seems to be enough of a high to kick in a depression.
11am // My mental health isnt the strongest, so when the Pregabalin wasnt hitting me as hard as I wanted after an hour or so of panic attacks and sobbing, I put 1.25mg of Lorazepam under my tongue. I stuck on some music and tried to zone out for a while, before realizing I hadnt fed myself yet and hitting the cupboards. Until 2pm is a blur to be honest, I think I ended up making a lot of sandwiches
2pm // But not long after that I started to come around from the Pregabalin and the anxiety was returning once again. At this point I was so ready for this day to be done, I just let the vodka flow.
The next few hours were less about getting high for enjoyment, than they were staying high, so I cant feel and survive the night. I ended up taking 2 X 1.25 Lorazepam, both started under the tongue which seemed to do enough to keep me dosed up in bed.
I know none of this is ideal for a mental health crisis, but these drugs kept me sedated enough so I didnt hurt myself and to me thats the most important thing. The Lorazepam under the tongue trick is lovely, I leave it for a couple of minutes then swallow it with a drink.
I somehow stayed up until 7:30 the next morning, I vaguely remember my housemates getting coffee I then popped another 600mg and cracked open the cans. Its now 5pm and Ive just had another 300mg, gonna have some Lorazepam soon and just curl up. Hopefully manage to sleep tonight!
